fields.text: 2019-05 (Proc. R. Soc. A 475:20190170; received 2019-03-25, accepted 2019-03-26 per PMC)

fields.label: Version
fields.text: Journal version (PMC copy read). arXiv v1 2018-06-15, v2 2019-02-06.

fields.label: Precise theorem
fields.text: No numbered quantitative unforgeability theorem. Conceptual definitions of S-money and existence-style arguments: S-money solves deterministic summoning tasks that standard quantum/classical money cannot (no-summoning theorem, ref [4]); privacy via bit commitment / zero-knowledge (stated as open composable-security questions).

fields.label: Input model
fields.text: Networks of issuer and user agents in Minkowski space; inputs at many network points; classical storage; no long-term quantum storage.

fields.label: Verifier model
fields.text: Local issuer agents validate presentations at spacetime points; consistency with relativistic causal structure.

fields.label: Adversary capabilities
fields.text: Not formalised as a single game; depends on scheme (bit commitment etc.).

fields.label: Proof dependencies
fields.text: Relativistic bit commitment; no-summoning theorem; zero-knowledge proofs (cited).

fields.label: Limitations
fields.text: Scenario/definition paper; no finite-size or noise analysis; privacy/composability left open.

fields.label: What QMint adds
fields.text: Nothing new. Source for spacetime-task semantics used by lane G; QMint must not claim to have introduced S-money or relativistic tokens.
